import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Check if any feature shows significant association with outcome
    p_values = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col]
        _, p = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, col], feats.x[feats.y==0, col])
        p_values.append(p)
    
    # If no feature is significantly associated, return empty design
    if all(p > 0.05 for p in p_values):
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Identify features with p < 0.05 and build correlation matrix
    significant_features = [fid for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids) if p_values[i] < 0.05]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation threshold
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in significant_features]].T)
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(significant_features)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(significant_features)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                to_remove.add(significant_features[j])
    
    filtered_features = [fid for fid in significant_features if fid not in to_remove]
    
    # Try to find a mechanism by fitting logistic regression
    if len(filtered_features) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in filtered_features]]
    y = feats.y
    
    # Fit logistic regression with cross-validation to check for stability
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)
    
    # For each stratum, fit model and check consistency
    strata_consistent = True
    for stratum in set(feats.stratum):
        mask = np.array(feats.stratum) == stratum
        if np.sum(mask) < 2:
            continue
        X_stratum = X_scaled[mask]
        y_stratum = y[mask]
        if len(np.unique(y_stratum)) < 2:
            continue
            
        try:
            model = LogisticRegression(penalty='l1', solver='liblinear', C=0.1)
            model.fit(X_stratum, y_stratum)
            if np.all(model.coef_[0] == 0):
                strata_consistent = False
                break
        except:
            strata_consistent = False
            break
    
    # If we have consistent effects across strata, return top features
    if strata_consistent and len(filtered_features) > 0:
        # Return top features by t-statistic
        t_stats = []
        for fid in filtered_features:
            col = feats.column(fid)
            t, _ = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, col], feats.x[feats.y==0, col])
            t_stats.append(abs(t))
        
        sorted_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:MAX_DRIVERS]
        drivers = tuple([filtered_features[i] for i in sorted_indices])
        
        # Include all features in regression
        columns = tuple(filtered_features)
        
        # No products for simplicity
        products = ()
        
        # Weighted score based on t-statistics
        loadings = dict(zip(filtered_features, [t_stats[i] for i in sorted_indices]))
        
        return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
    
    # Default case: no mechanism found
    return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
